overall_reason: The file list is warm-grey neutrals (#ebebe9 stage, #f6f5f4 panel) with one blue used only for the selected row: a #eef4fd tint and a blue file icon; the column heads use a cool #8a8f94.

score.reason: T-PALETTE-ROLES and T-ACCENT-DOSAGE pass (one hue, one role: selection), and T-NEUTRALS finds one drift: cool grey column heads on a warm panel.

findings.title: Neutrals hold one temperature
findings.evidence: The palette table counts 7 cool neutrals against 28 untinted: the column heads are #8a8f94 and the ink #35414a, both blue-grey, on a warm #f6f5f4 panel and #ebebe9 stage.
findings.before: Cool #8a8f94 and #35414a text on a warm #f6f5f4 panel
findings.after: Text greys tinted to the warm panel, or an untinted set
findings.why: A small temperature mismatch between text and panel; it is the one place the neutrals drift.

strengths: Blue appears only on the selected row (tint #eef4fd and the file icon), so selection is the one coloured state.
Placeholder rows are a quiet grey that never competes with the selected row.
not_investigated: Brand authority: the run has no 00-contract.md, so no brand colours or design system were available; T-COLOUR-SOURCE was judged from the composition alone, and the visitor mode was taken as Operate (a product UI component).
T-DARK-MODE: the stylesheet ships a dark class theme, but the capture rendered only the light scheme, so dark mode is not verified.
T-GRADIENT-STOPS and contrast: owned by the sweep (A11-001); small-text contrast hits are not restated here.
